# Siela A. Bynoe (D): NYS Senate, District 6

<!-- Generated by build.py from meta.json and claims.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Siela A. Bynoe's** campaign website ([campaign home page](https://www.sielaforsenate.com/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Incumbent. Opponent: [Matthew Capp](../capp-matthew/) (R).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/bynoe-siela> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

Her career history checks out against county, Senate and press records. But the page is out of date: it says she is in her fifth term in the County Legislature, when she has been a State Senator since January 2025. Dollar figures for her housing work are unsourced.

1. Housing authority roles, school board service and the 2014 special election are all confirmed.
2. The "now in her fifth term" line describes a seat she left; it never mentions she is the incumbent senator.
